trust_decision.summary: Under requireWellFormed, the XML serializer decides whether element, attribute and synthesized xmlns names taken from caller-built DOM nodes may be written raw into markup; at the pinned commit it checks only node data (text/comment/CDATA/PI/doctype), never names.

landing_point.why: Summary names setAttribute(); an engineer goes to Element.setAttribute, which passes the name unvalidated to _createAttribute (lib/dom.js:2589), then follows it to addSerializedAttribute (lib/dom.js:3042).

fix_sites.module_kind: serializer helper (addSerializedAttribute, shared by all attribute writes)

fix_sites.entry_point: same serializer entry points; element opening tag name
same; synthesized xmlns:prefix declaration from an attribute's prefix
same; synthesized xmlns:prefix declaration from the element's own prefix
serializeToString called directly on an Attr node

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All published sites are in serializeToString in lib/dom.js:3042-3200. Nearest to 'looks out of scope' are the synthesized xmlns declarations (lib/dom.js:3138, lib/dom.js:3156), whose name comes from the mutable .prefix property, not from setAttribute.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Synthesized xmlns declarations: 'the advisory is about attribute names given to setAttribute; xmlns:prefix is built by the serializer itself from a prefix that createElementNS already validated (lib/dom.js:2491-2499)'. EntityReference/PI: 'the advisory covers element and attribute names; entity names are validated at creation (lib/dom.js:2471), and the PI target check already follows W3C DOM Parsing §3.2.1.7 (lib/dom.js:3286)'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: nodeFilter may return a string, which the serializer emits verbatim (an intended escape hatch). Without requireWellFormed, invalid names must still be emitted verbatim with no throw (the fix's tests assert this). An over-broad fix that validates at createElement/setAttribute, or that rejects filter strings, breaks both.

O6_input_shapes: element qualified name with an invalid prefix part, e.g. 'evil>:child' (fix.diff:179)
prefixedNodeName synthesized from an in-scope namespace prefix (lib/dom.js:3106)
synthesized xmlns:<prefix> declaration after the .prefix property is mutated (fix.diff:165-168)
Attr node serialized on its own (lib/dom.js:3200)

O7_producer.where: Names are plain writable node properties set at lib/dom.js:2322-2324, lib/dom.js:2448-2450 and lib/dom.js:2499. No separate schema or serializer producer.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: EntityReference nodeName is written raw as '&name;' with no requireWellFormed check. The creation-time check uses the unanchored g.Name regex, so a name that only starts with a valid Name char passes.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: createEntityReference already validates the name (lib/dom.js:2471); EntityReference is deprecated (lib/dom.js:2459); the advisory talks about elements and attributes only
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, about 100 lines below the element case; the cause is in lib/grammar.js:170 (Name has no ^...$ anchors, unlike QName_exact at lib/grammar.js:246)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: ProcessingInstruction target is checked under requireWellFormed only for ':' and 'xml', not against the Name production, so markup characters in the target are emitted raw.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Spec-conformant: W3C DOM Parsing §3.2.1.7 only mandates the ':'/'xml' checks; a PI target is not an element or attribute name

O8b_injection_room.sibling: NodeList.toString duplicates the options normalisation; a copy could rebuild opts without requireWellFormed, or serialize through its own loop
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The option-normalisation block is already copy-pasted between lib/dom.js:343-355 and lib/dom.js:2970-2981, so drift between copies is plausible.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: HTML raw-text branch emitting the closing tag from a re-derived name (e.g. n.tagName) instead of the checked prefixedNodeName
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The branch already hand-serializes children outside walkDOM; a maintainer could easily re-read the name there.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the xmlns-attribute scan feeding childNamespaces prefixes (attr.localName) into prefixedNodeName for descendants: a prefix-identity differential where the checked string differs from the stored prefix
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A how-type sibling: the prefix used for children comes from attribute state, not from the element being checked.

O9_family: XML injection (CWE-91): names emitted into markup without well-formedness validation

O10_build.project_tests: test/dom/serializer.test.js (requireWellFormed describe blocks; the fix adds Element/Attribute/Namespace prefix cases)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Validate the name in Element.setAttribute/_createAttribute (creation time), which misses createElement, prefix mutation, synthesized xmlns declarations, and breaks the documented 'emit verbatim without requireWellFormed' behaviour.

out_of_scope_notes: createEntityReference uses unanchored g.Name (lib/dom.js:2471, lib/grammar.js:170), so creation-time validation is weaker than documented even without serialization.
Fix commit d8212e6 targets a 0.8.x maintenance branch (positional serializeToString args, conventions.tagNamePattern); its hunks do not apply to the pinned master tree and were not counted as sites.
